review_candidates.title: Revenue and Trade Management Specialist
review_candidates.description: About the Role: For our Ferrero Bulgaria business unit based in Sofia, we are looking for a Revenue and Trade Management Specialist who will be the driver of the Profit Pool evolution in the Bulgarian Business Unit. You will be leading the Value Maneuver agenda and optimizing the five levers of Revenue Management. This role requires building a strong understanding of the local business priorities, while ensuring full alignment with Group and Area guidelines. In this position, you will ensure business compliance and consistency with Group standards, while continuously strengthening Revenue Management capabilities in line with Group and Area Revenue & Trade strategies. You will also play a key role in fostering transparent communication on Revenue Management topics with Area and Group functions, supporting alignment and effective collaboration across all stakeholders. Main Responsibilities: At the heart of this Revenue and Trade Management role is the ability to turn data , insights and processes into clear commercial impact. You will play a key role in ensuring strong visibility, discipline and optimization across all revenue management levers, supporting smarter decisions and sustainable growth. You will play a central role in Pricing Optimization , coordinating the value maneuver process , analyzing various masses of data like market trends and competitor positioning and ensuring strong implementation to drive Profit Pool growth. Critical part of the role is Promotion Management and Trade Terms , where you will be responsible to follow Gross-to-Net evolution , evaluate promotion effectiveness and embed ROI-driven decision-making across all activities channels, ensuring alignment with commercial policies. Driving Product and Customer Mix Optimization , you will provide recommendations to enhance portfolio value , channel mix and customer profitability, identifying opportunities for growth and margin improvement. You will take full ownership of performance tracking by collecting and structuring proof of in-store performance across assortment, visibility, pricing and promotional activities. By ensuring proper archiving and accessibility, you will enable strong analysis , benchmarking and continuous improvement. A leading part of the role is maintaining the Company Calendar , ensuring all commercial deadlines , customer commitments and milestones are clearly defined and respected through proactive coordination. You will be the sole creator of a Company Dashboard and commercial reporting framework, consolidating key indicators such as sell-in, sell-out data , market share, distribution and competitor performance. You will be in close day-to-day collaboration with Sales to ensure customer agreement governance and commercial compliance, validating offers, monitoring execution vs. agreements and identifying gaps and value recovery opportunities. Together with Sales, you will contribute to Customer Planning , supporting customer reviews, scorecards, promo planning and action plans , translating insights into clear and impactful recommendations. In addition, you will act as a key enabler of Commercial Capabilities , supporting adoption of systems , tools and processes (e.g., SAP TM, SAP ATMA, Customer Profitability tools) and contributing to a strong Revenue & Trade Management culture. Where relevant, you will also support team development and capability building, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement aligned with company values. About You: We are looking for a professional who has 5-7 years of experience in Revenue Growth Management, Trade Marketing or similar commercial roles , ideally within the FMCG environment where pace , complexity and results orientation define everyday work. Experience across both Modern Trade and Traditional Trade channels is essential, with a strong understanding of category and channel development in different market contexts. A background in Sales or Key Account Management is considered a strong advantage, adding valuable commercial perspective . You combine analytical thinking with clear communication and coordination skills , allowing you to translate complexity into clarity and action . Fluency in Bulgarian and English is required, along with very good MS Office skills with advanced Excel, Power BI and interpreting data from sources such as Nielsen (NIQ). A university degree in Business, Economics or a related field is expected. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of market, consumer and financial dynamics , as well as channel behavior and category growth levers across food segments . You know how to develop and execute channel strategies, balancing long-term vision with practical implementation . Strong knowledge of trade spend management , pricing and commercial planning is key to success in this role. Comfort navigating cross-functional environments and influencing stakeholders without direct authority is critical. You collaborate effectively across teams, demonstrate strong communication skills and align different perspectives to drive outcomes. You are detail-oriented, responsible and resilient , with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high-quality execution. What We Offer: Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here. About Ferrero: Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946. Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many iconic brands sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com. DE&I at Ferrero: Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding. Find out more here.

The role is responsible for ensuring maximum availability and performance of confectionery processing, production, packaging, and utility equipment while supporting production, quality, food safety, safety, environmental, and business objectives. Responsibilities & Outcomes 1. Engineering and Maintenance Management Key Responsibilities Develop and implement preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs for all plant equipment. Establish machine-specific maintenance schedules and ensure timely execution. Ensure availability and reliability of confectionery processing and packaging equipment . Monitor equipment performance and implement initiatives to improve plant reliability. Coordinate engineering resources to minimize production downtime. Ensure maintenance activities comply with engineering, food safety, and GMP standards. Provide technical support to production teams during breakdowns, start-ups, and changeovers. 2. Reliability and Equipment Performance Key Responsibilities Monitor and analyze machine breakdowns and equipment failures. Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions. Track and improve MTBF and MTTR. Develop reliability-centered maintenance programs for critical confectionery equipment. Implement condition-monitoring techniques. Identify recurring equipment failures and develop long-term engineering solutions. Analyze equipment-related production losses and recommend improvement initiatives. Improve the reliability of critical processing and packaging assets. Relevant Equipment May Include Chocolate processing and tempering equipment. Chocolate moulding and depositing machines. Enrobing machines. Candy and toffee cooking systems. Batch and continuous cooking systems. Mixing and kneading equipment. Biscuit/wafer processing equipment, where applicable. Cooling tunnels and refrigeration systems. Conveyors and material handling systems. Wrapping, flow-pack, cartoning and secondary packaging machines. Metal detectors, checkweighers and coding equipment. Outcomes Improved equipment reliability. Reduced unplanned downtime. Improved MTBF and reduced MTTR. Reduction in recurring equipment failures. Improved OEE of critical production lines. 3. Utilities Management Key Responsibilities Manage all plant utilities required for confectionery manufacturing, including: Water treatment systems. Boilers and steam systems. Air compressors. Refrigeration systems. Chillers and cooling systems. HVAC and air-handling systems. Power distribution systems. Wastewater treatment facilities. Ensure uninterrupted utility services to support production requirements. Monitor utility consumption and identify opportunities for optimization. Ensure utility systems comply with safety, environmental, food safety, and regulatory requirements. Develop preventive and predictive maintenance programs for utility equipment. Monitor refrigeration and temperature-controlled systems critical to chocolate and confectionery production. Outcomes Utility availability of ≥98%. Reduced utility-related production interruptions. Improved water, electricity, steam, compressed-air and refrigeration efficiency. Reduced energy consumption per unit of production. Reliable temperature and environmental control for sensitive confectionery processes. 4. Spare Parts and Inventory Management Key Responsibilities Ensure availability of critical engineering and maintenance spare parts. Monitor spare-part consumption and inventory levels. Review weekly and monthly spare-part variances and implement corrective actions. Collaborate with procurement to ensure timely acquisition of engineering materials. Establish appropriate stock levels for critical production and utility equipment. Identify critical spares for imported confectionery processing and packaging machinery. Review repair and CAPEX requirements and provide clear technical justification. Outcomes Critical spare-part availability of ≥95%. Reduced stock variances. Reduced equipment downtime caused by spare-part shortages. Improved inventory control. Engineering expenditure maintained within approved budget. 5. Engineering Budget and Cost Management Key Responsibilities Prepare and manage the Engineering and Maintenance budget. Monitor maintenance expenditure against approved budgets. Identify opportunities to reduce maintenance and utility costs. Evaluate repair-versus-replacement decisions. Develop technical and financial justifications for CAPEX proposals. Monitor contractor and service-provider costs. Outcomes Maintenance spending controlled within budget. Cost savings through improved equipment reliability and energy efficiency. Investment decisions supported by clear technical and operational justification. 6. Engineering Projects and Capital Expenditure Key Responsibilities Plan, coordinate and implement engineering projects. Lead equipment installation, modification, commissioning and plant expansion projects. Develop technical specifications for new confectionery production and packaging equipment. Evaluate new technologies and equipment to improve capacity, quality and efficiency. Manage engineering projects within approved budgets and timelines. Coordinate contractors, OEMs and service providers. Lead commissioning and performance verification of new equipment. Support line automation, modernization and capacity expansion projects. Outcomes Engineering projects completed within budget and approved timelines. Successful installation and commissioning of new equipment. Improved production capacity and efficiency. Successful integration of new processing and packaging technologies. ] Academic and Professional Qualifications Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in: Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Mechatronics Engineering Industrial Engineering or an equivalent engineering discipline from a recognized institution. Professional Qualifications Registration with the relevant engineering professional body will be an added advantage. Relevant professional certifications in maintenance, reliability, TPM or Lean Manufacturing will be an advantage. Minimum Experience 7–10 years of engineering/maintenance experience within an FMCG manufacturing environment. At least 5 years of experience in confectionery, chocolate, bakery, biscuits, candy, snacks or related food manufacturing. Experience managing high-speed confectionery production and packaging lines . Experience in a supervisory/management-level engineering or maintenance position. Relevant Skills, Experience & Attributes Hands-on experience with confectionery manufacturing equipment . Experience with chocolate processing, tempering, moulding, depositing, enrobing, cooking, cooling and/or related confectionery processes. Experience with high-speed packaging machinery. Strong knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems. Knowledge of PLCs, automation, sensors, drives and control systems. Knowledge of preventive, predictive and reliability-centered maintenance. Strong utilities-management experience. Experience with refrigeration, chillers, boilers, compressed air and HVAC systems. Experience with SAP maintenance modules or equivalent CMMS. Strong troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis skills. Knowledge of TPM, Lean Manufacturing and 5S methodologies. Ability to interpret mechanical drawings and electrical schematics. Strong understanding of food safety, GMP and HACCP requirements. Ability to manage contractors, OEMs and technical service providers. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Team Leadership & Capability Development Lead, coach and develop the Engineering and Maintenance team. Develop and maintain an Engineering Skill Matrix. Conduct competency assessments and identify technical skill gaps. Coordinate OEM and internal technical training programs. Ensure effective shift coverage and timely maintenance support. Develop a strong culture of ownership, discipline, safety and continuous improvement. Mentor technicians and supervisors in advanced troubleshooting and reliability practices. Key Competencies Hands-on technical and problem-solving ability. Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills. Analytical and data-driven decision making. Strong planning, execution and follow-up. RCA and continuous improvement mindset. Cost and business awareness. Effective communication and stakeholder management. Ability to work under pressure and manage priorities. Strong safety, quality and food-safety mindset. Ability to coach and develop engineering talent. Strong understanding of production, maintenance and engineering KPIs. Ability to manage multiple engineering priorities in a fast-paced FMCG environment.
